title: Autopay setup failing for some users

acceptableCauses.mechanism: Bank sahyadri's mandate API started timing out (504 after 8 s) at 10:10 IST; only its users fail, which overall success (~94%) hides.

keyCounterevidence: Only bank sahyadri fails; the other banks' success is unchanged after the deploy.
NPCI-wide problems hit every bank; this hits one.
notes: Requires grouping mandate_success_rate (or errors) by bank.
